releaseNotes: More than one My Player, with no maximum: flag every kid on the roster, then pick which kids are playing in the Start Game menu (more than one at once). Each kid’s at-bats are tracked to their own personal stats, with a player picker on the Stats page. New Hype Music playlist for inning changes: manage songs in the sidebar Music tab (no length limit), with Play/Pause, Next and Stop controls at the top of the game page; walk-up Play fades hype out first, then announcement and walk-up music as normal. The grand slam sound clip is removed; scoring and the on-screen banner are unchanged. No other gameplay changes.
